ticks.note: Tick 1: no call in either chart; both lamps are off.
A press: both charts move from `Idle` to `Waiting`, whose entry action lights the lamp.
The button is released, but both charts stay in `Waiting`: the state is the memory.
A second press while a call is registered changes nothing: `Waiting` has no transition for the button.
The lift arrives: `if arrived go to Idle` fires in both, and the exit action switches the lamp off.

A press while the doors are still open. `CallButton`'s `Idle` tests only `button`, registers the press and lights its lamp. `CallButtonFixed` tests `button && !arrived`, which is false: its lamp stays off.
The doors are still open, so `CallButton` serves its needless call at once: a one-tick flash of the lamp.
A new call in both charts.

The lift arrives in the same tick as another press. Both charts are in `Waiting`, whose only transition is `if arrived go to Idle`: the press is served together with the earlier call, and both lamps go off.
